entities.name: PMID:25451038
observations: 2015 Obesity study tested dietary genistein, resveratrol, quercetin, and vitamin D in aged ovariectomized rats.
The highest-dose blend prevented the ovariectomy-associated increase in serum ALT, but lower-dose blends increased serum free fatty acids and hepatic triglycerides.

entities.name: Genistein
observations: Used in ovariectomized-rat dietary blends at 500 or 1000 mg/kg.

entities.name: Resveratrol
observations: Used in ovariectomized-rat dietary blends at 200 or 400 mg/kg.

entities.name: Quercetin
observations: Used in ovariectomized-rat dietary blends at 1000 or 2000 mg/kg.

entities.name: ALT protection
observations: In aged ovariectomized rats, the highest-dose genistein-resveratrol-quercetin blend prevented the ovariectomy-associated rise in serum ALT, although hepatic triglycerides increased with some blends.
